title: Answer: a self is a patch of vibes that acts as one, still open

statements.text: A self is a patch of vibes that acts as one. Vibe explores whether it is the region that loses the most when cut: its integration, read from one snapshot of the tones and links at one beat, so the border of a self is a fact of the present state. A self's tone is the sum of its members' tones and nothing more. This is open: every ledger row for selves is partial, and on the working rule shared history gives no bounded self (E-SLF-0177).
statements.scope: open. The self experiments mostly ran on older rules, a known attractor model or the mesh graph alone
